name.zh: 仰卧单膝抱胸（托马斯测试）

purpose.zh: 检查髋前侧是否紧张，同时放松髋前侧
purpose.en: Check for tight hip flexors while gently stretching the front of the hip.

text.zh: 一侧膝盖抱向胸口，另一条腿放松贴地
text.en: Hug one knee to your chest and let the other leg rest long on the floor

text.zh: 呼气时轻轻拉近膝盖，吸气时放松
text.en: Draw the knee in gently as you exhale and ease off as you inhale.

text.zh: 观察伸直的大腿是否离开地面
text.en: Notice whether the straight thigh lifts off the floor.

commonErrors.zh: 伸直的腿主动用力压地或抬起
commonErrors.en: Pressing the straight leg down or lifting it on purpose.
Pulling the knee in too hard so the lower back lifts.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时减小抱膝幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Hug the knee less if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
